name: CSOP Hang Seng Index Daily (2x) Leveraged Product
summary: The CSOP Hang Seng Index Daily (2x) Leveraged Product, an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) under the CSOP Leveraged and Inverse Series, is overseen by CSOP Asset Management Limited. This fund, which was established in Hong Kong on March 14, 2017, concentrates its investments within Hong Kong's public equity markets. Its primary objective is to deliver double the daily performance of the Hang Seng Index. To achieve this, it strategically utilizes financial derivatives, including futures, to invest across a broad spectrum of companies from various industries and all market capitalization sizes.
